title: Schools and religion: New Orleans University and Garden District
summary: Family religion was part Catholic, part Methodist; he attended New Orleans University and later McDonogh 25 after the family moved.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Was that one of the public schools?
Was the other a Catholic? What was your religion? Were you Catholic?

Well, no, part of my people, one side a Catholic and the other the Methodist. So I started public school at Tom LeFont School, when I was in 3rd grade. I finished Tom LeFont School and then I, my mother rather, enrolled me in New Orleans University, up at Valmont and St. Charles. Yeah, Bun Johnson went there too, years before.

So I went there for quite a while then we moved to part of New Orleans called the Garden District. And then I later on attended McDonald Number 25. It was down on Rampart Street High School down there. And I left there and went back to New Orleans University.
